My husband, Robert Gentry, who had the Sabine Index newspaper for 47 years, took this photo from his front row seat. It was black and white. Some commenters have mentioned ￼ Elvis’ stage wear was white. I would imagine the digital colorization read that color as gold. Here is the original.
